Tom (EMEA Eng): Quick policy q: our global holiday calendar lists July 1 as company holiday, but in JP that's a normal working day. A few folks in JP want to swap it for a local holiday later. Can they carry over or swap?
Hiro (IC - JP): I have Obon off in Aug. Can I use the company day off July 1 as a floating day and keep Obon as usual?
Aisha (People Ops): We support regional swaps where local law allows. Two options: 1) swap company global holiday for a local date (adds a floating day to the employee's balance tied to that region), or 2) take comp-time if you work on the global date.
Sofia (Payroll Intl): To clarify: swaps are implemented as a region-specific holiday mapping in payroll. Please submit the `Holiday Swap Request` within 30 days before the calendar date. Payroll will reflect the swap as `Floating-Hol` in the next export.
Hiro (IC - JP): Any tax/employment implications? I don't want a surprise on payslip.
Sofia (Payroll Intl): Good question. For most countries it's neutral; we still track as time-off, not pay. In some jurisdictions (e.g., BR, ZA) statutory holiday pay rules apply and payroll will flag for review. We'll notify affected employees if extra steps needed.
Tom (EMEA Eng): What about carryover? If someone can't use their swapped floating day, can it roll into next year?
Lina (People Ops Lead): Floating days from swaps expire per local policy. Default: use within 12 months of the swapped date. If a manager-approved business need prevents usage, People Ops can approve an exceptional carryover on a case-by-case basis.
Aisha (People Ops): Operational steps: 1) Employee files `Holiday Swap Request` (link in handbook). 2) Manager approves. 3) Payroll confirms region mapping. 4) HRbot tags the request with `region-swap` and notifies People Ops for cross-region checks.
HRbot: Automated: will add `region-swap` tag for requests flagged with a non-local holiday. Enable for JP region?
Aisha (People Ops): Yes please enable for JP and APAC nodes for the July 1 window.
Hiro (IC - JP): Thanks — will file the swap request. One more: if someone is part-time, does swap pro-rate?
Sofia (Payroll Intl): Yes pro-rated. Part-time swap days are calculated based on FTE. Add `part-time` in the request form and payroll will apply pro-rata rules.
Tom (EMEA Eng): Nice, this should reduce confusion. Can we get a short FAQ blurb added to the handbook?
Lina (People Ops Lead): On it. I'll draft a 4-bullet FAQ and post the handbook link here when live.
Hiro (IC - JP): :bow: Thanks everyone!
